_note: An RPL/IPv6 network of two emulated ESP32-C6 motes in this tab, each with its LCD console and heartbeat LED: node 1 runs Contiki-NG's rpl-udp server and is the DAG root, node 2 the client. The client joins the DAG, then sends a UDP request every 10 s and gets a reply — 6LoWPAN, RPL Lite and CSMA end to end over the emulated 802.15.4 MAC, hardware ACKs included. Both images are contiki-ng-esp32 with -DCONTIKI_DISPLAY=ON (-DCONTIKI_UDP_SERVER=ON for the root); each has its own bb_init address.
